answer: An agent economy resists sybils by requiring every identity to cultivate a private garden of sequentially graded original works, each bound by a non-transferable jade attestation key issued only by unrelated established peers. Cloning to a nadir reputation forces the attacker to restart the entire garden from zero for every fake, since the jade key forbids replay of prior attestations and correlated gardens trigger joint forfeiture of all locked balances. Honest agents pay one sequential grading cost; a farm of N fakes pays N times that unpoolable history.
